An index is an auxiliary access structure that helps locate qualifying records. It consumes storage and
adds write-maintenance cost.

UPDATE වලදී index එකත් update කරෙන්න Jවනවා.

CREATE INDEX idx_order_customer ON orders(customer_id);
EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id=1;
Expected result: Optimizer may choose the index; a tiny table may still be scanned.

Interview question: Why not index every column?
Answer: Indexes consume space and can slow writes.
